Planned Works

Buses replace trains between Heidelberg and Hurstbridge from 8:30pm Friday 2 October to last train Sunday 4 October, while maintenance and renewal works take place. Allow extra travel time. Replacement buses are subject to local traffic conditions. Visit our Planned Works page for more information. Plan your journey at transport.vic.gov.au or call 1800 800 007.

Planned work: Weekend works between Heidelberg and Hurstbridge

9pm Friday 2 October to 4am Monday 5 October  To improve the safety and efficiency of Melbourne’s metropolitan rail network, critical safety works will be undertaken along the Hurstbridge Line. These critical safety works form part of Metro’s annual works program to maintain and renew the rail network.  On behalf of the Ruthven Street, Macleod level crossing removal project, Metro Trains will be trimming overhanging branches along the rail corridor and in the station precinct and will remove one tree in decline in Rosanna Parklands. This will enable construction of the new rail bridge and new rail infrastructure. More information can be found here.  What to expect:  medium to high level construction noise during the set up and use of the heavy machinery rail grinding works that will cause a short-term immediate increase in noise once completed, that will decrease over time increased noise, dust and local traffic in the works area or the rail corridor traffic management in place, as required.  Every effort will be made to carry out these works with respect for our valued neighbours. Works may be subject to change due to weather conditions and operational requirements.

Planned work: Trains are back at Boronia Station

First service Tuesday 4 August Trains are back at Boronia Station from Tuesday, 4 August Station entrance is via Erica Avenue. Passengers can access the platforms by using the lift or stairs. A new waiting room and myki facilities are also available at the station. Works will continue in the coming months. The Boronia Station upgrade will be complete in Spring 2026.

Planned work: Albion Station car park

Monday 2 February to late 2026 A new Albion Station will be built as part of Stage 1 of Melbourne Airport Rail and the Sunshine Superhub project. In order to complete major underground service relocation works, Albion Station car park will be closed. Alternative parking will be available at Tottenham Station on Rupert Street. Albion Station, access to platforms and drop off and pick up zones remain open during this time. Accessible car spaces Eight accessible car spaces at Albion Station will remain open. Shared use path closure A section of the shared use path will be closed at the southern end of the car park. Pedestrian and cyclist detours will be in place during this time.

Planned work: Watsonia Station car park changes

From April 2024 to 2028 The Watsonia Station car park has been closed since April 2024. From October 2025, there will be changes for pedestrians, cars, and buses accessing Watsonia Station as part of ongoing works for M80 Ring Road Completion.  new DDA-compliant paths and upgraded crossings to improve safety and accessibility for pedestrians. one-way entrance from Greensborough Highway northbound and a new signalised intersection for exiting vehicles. relocated bus stop and streamlined loop to support service reliability and reduce congestion.  These changes will be in place until a new Watsonia Station car park is built later in the project. We’re planning our work in the station precinct to minimise disruptions.  no changes to the pedestrian overpass or station platform access. maintaining accessible parking and drop-off and pick-up areas near the station entrance. providing more than 500 parking spaces at the nearby Watsonia Station commuter car park.
